rationale: Cycle 006 compiled and imported the plugin and harness without D3-v3 errors, but command-line -quit left Unity hung after successful shutdown invocation. This cycle removes only command-line -quit and delegates terminal exit to the known-answer harness after its receipt is written.
mandatoryQualification: GC.Alloc marker is observed with Int64 allocation-size metadata
known array sizes preserve monotonic and bounded-overhead scaling
repeated small-object allocations preserve exact event and byte scaling
GC collection does not change cumulative allocated bytes
same-thread events are counted and foreign-thread events are excluded
bytes-per-second is a finite positive exact recomputation from bytes and elapsed seconds
invalid metadata and overflow inputs contribute zero
